rules.logic: (BIOC(MP-035 python3 Enumerates WordPress Authors via the REST API and Author Sitemap) OR ABIOC(MP-035 Scripted wp-login Credential Burst From a Host Process) OR BIOC(MP-035 python3 Dumps a MongoDB and Writes an Exfiltration Manifest) OR BIOC(MP-035 tar Compresses a Database Dump Under a python3 Causality Chain) OR BIOC(MP-035 Shell Under python3 Opens a Reverse Shell Over dev tcp to Port 4444) OR BIOC(MP-035 wscript Launches Hidden PowerShell With an EncodedCommand TCPClient)) AND (ABIOC(MP-035 NGFW Recurring python3 Sessions to an External HTTP Proxy) OR ABIOC(MP-035 NGFW Large Upload From python3 to a Rare External IP on Port 8080) OR ABIOC(MP-035 NGFW Recurring Communications to the Actor Server on Port 4444) OR IOC(162.243.3.92) OR IOC(104.238.38.202)) AND BIOC(MP-035 Jailbreak System-Prompt Override Sent to an Unsanctioned GenAI Provider) within 3600s on the same endpoint entity (xdr_data agent_hostname = panw_ngfw_traffic_raw endpoint_device_name = the AI Access source host, the src_host every leg carries) -> one BUGSTER incident whose summary names the python3 tooling lineage, the proxy and actor-server destinations and the jailbreak attempts to both providers.
